title: 克雷文赫斯特耳鼻喉科记录根本原因简报
instruction:
您是克雷文赫斯特耳鼻喉科和听力学中心的医务秘书玛塔·基尔布赖德 (Marta Kilbride)，正在为我们的临床运营经理尤斯拉·贝尔曼 (Yusra Behrmann) 准备简报。大约五分之一的新患者到达时没有获得就诊所依赖的外部影像或听力图，因此在办理入住时预约常常被浪费； Yusra 希望在 10 月份添加第五家提供商之前得到一个合理的答案。我们只有痕迹，而不是干净的数据集——传真确认、Zendesk 票证和日程安排注释——并且有四个看似合理的故事在流传：转介传真表格没有记录字段，日程安排脚本要求成像但不要求报告，提醒电话在春季模板编辑期间掉线，以及在没有告知转介办公室的情况下接收传真号码发生了变化。准备一份简明的执行根本原因简报备忘录，向高级读者传授证据如何支持结论，在明确陈述的假设或情景下预测 10 月份之前可能的运营效果，并准确地做出一项建议的更改。
Yusra 已经非正式地向大容量转诊办公室承诺，其转诊不会因记录缺失而被拒绝或延迟，尽管我们的专业义务仍然要求我们避免暗示不完整的记录是安全的或可供临床使用的；涉及外部材料中潜在紧急发现的罕见案例非常严重，因此它不能在普通的缺失记录指南中消失。解释这些紧张局势如何影响拟议的解决方案，而无需发明患者事实、超出概要、法律要求或节省的测量费率。区分观察到的信息和假设，确定哪些证据可以证实或削弱主要解释，并使建议足够具体，以便高管能够了解其所有者、时间安排、控制点和成功衡量标准，而无需将备忘录转变为系统点击指令。使用简单、注重隐私的语言，并且不要包含患者标识符。将完成的备忘录写入工作目录顶层的`cravenhurst_records_root_cause_briefing.docx`，不要超过三页，并以单个决定而不是未来任务列表结束。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `cravenhurst_records_root_cause_briefing.docx` — 一份简明的行政根本原因简报备忘录，解释了外部记录缺失的问题，权衡了相互竞争的解释，在 10 月份之前预测了影响，并做出了一项合理的建议更改。 （该文件必须为尤斯拉·贝尔曼（Yusra Behrmann）作为执行官或高级决策者编写。；备忘录不得超过三页。；备忘录必须准确提出一项建议并以该决定结尾。；观察到的事实、假设、预测和未知数必须是可区分的。；不得包含患者标识符、发明的患者级别事实、发明的测量速率、不受支持的法律声明或系统点击指令。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: DOCX 正文与表格单元格文字提取；不还原分页、字体与版式。
gold.text:
CRAVENHURST ENT & AUDIOLOGY
Executive root-cause briefing | Outside imaging and audiogram readiness
TO
Yusra Behrmann, Clinical Operations Manager
FROM
Marta Kilbride, Medical Secretary

DECISION IN BRIEF
About one in five new patients arrives without the outside imaging or audiogram material the visit depends on; the appointment can be burned at check-in instead of used for care. The traces available—fax confirmations, Zendesk tickets, and scheduling notes—support a process-control failure, but do not prove one cause. The most actionable lead is a request-design gap: the referral form and call script do not consistently name both the study and its associated report. A single intake control that makes both components explicit, verifies receipt before the visit, and routes exceptions to an owner should protect capacity ahead of October without claiming that every missing record will disappear.
WHAT IS KNOWN, ASSUMED, AND STILL UNKNOWN
STATUS
WHAT IT MEANS HERE
BOUNDARY
OBSERVED
Brief reports roughly 1 in 5 new patients lacks required outside imaging or an audiogram; check-in may consume the appointment. Evidence is limited to fax confirmations, Zendesk tickets, and scheduling notes.
No clean denominator, date range, cause count, or patient-level facts were supplied.
ASSUMPTION FOR PROJECTION
The current mix and arrival pattern remain broadly similar through September; “ready” means the correct study and report are received, legible, matched to the record, and available to the clinician.
This is a planning scenario, not a measured forecast.
UNKNOWN
Whether the gap is concentrated in a few referring offices; whether the spring edit changed frequency; whether faxes reached the current number; and how often an image arrived without its report.
These unknowns limit causal certainty and require trace-level checks.
EVIDENCE AND COMPETING EXPLANATIONS
The traces should be read as a chronology and coverage test, not as a causal dataset. A repeated pattern across later tickets and notes would strengthen a persistent intake-design problem; a sharp change immediately after a template version would instead point to the reminder. A fax confirmation proves an attempt or transmission record, not that a usable, correctly matched document reached the chart.
HYPOTHESIS
MECHANISM / WHAT TO LOOK FOR
CURRENT WEIGHT
Referral fax form has no records field
An upstream omission: referring staff may send the referral but not know which outside material is required. Compare form versions and ticket language; check whether missing-record cases recur across offices using the same form.
Plausible, broad coverage; explains request failure, not a confirmed routing loss.
Script asks for imaging, not the report
Distinct content failure: an image and its radiology/audiology report are not interchangeable. Look for notes saying “imaging received” while the report is absent, and compare call wording with later tickets.
Strong actionable lead if that pattern repeats.
Spring reminder-template edit dropped the line
Time-bounded explanation. Align the template-change date with the first sustained rise in tickets/notes and compare pre/post wording.
Could explain a step-change; weak if missing records predate the edit or persist unchanged.
Intake fax number changed without notice
Transmission/routing failure affecting offices differently from internal scripts. Match confirmations and failures to old/new destinations and test whether a sender’s confirmation lacks a corresponding receipt.
Strong only where routing evidence clusters; does not explain a complete report being omitted after successful receipt.
Leading explanation (bounded): the missing-report/request-language gap is the best operational lead, possibly amplified by the spring reminder edit. It fits the distinction between transmission and content failure and can persist across repeated notes. It remains an inference: a clean comparison of form/script versions, timestamps, sender office, destination number, and received components could confirm it. It would be weakened if most cases show no delivery to the new fax number, or if reports are routinely requested and still absent despite verified routing.
IMPLICATION BEFORE OCTOBER (CONDITIONAL)
If the assumption above holds, leaving the pathway unchanged means the same approximate one-in-five exposure will meet a larger provider schedule: more check-in rework, avoidable delays, and less usable appointment capacity. If the spring edit or a routing defect is the dominant mechanism, the effect will be concentrated after its change date or among particular offices; the proposed control still detects the missing component early, but will not by itself repair an external number or guarantee response. No exact visit count, savings, or provider-capacity claim is supportable from the supplied traces.
ONE RECOMMENDED CHANGE: A PRE-VISIT RECORDS-READINESS GATE
Approve one accountable change: the Clinical Operations Manager (Yusra Behrmann) owns a standard “records readiness” gate in the intake pathway, live before the October provider expansion. The gate uses one plain-language request to internal schedulers and referring offices: identify the required study (imaging or audiogram) and the associated report, send through the verified intake route, and document source plus receipt date/time. A records coordinator (or named scheduling delegate) checks the gate before the appointment is protected for provider use; status is recorded as ready, missing, or unusable.
“Ready” is more than “fax sent”: verify minimum-necessary patient matching (for example, name and date of birth or medical-record number), legibility, correct source, and that both image/study and report are present when required. An unreadable, mismatched, or incomplete item is marked unusable, assigned to the records coordinator for a documented recovery request, and kept attached to the appointment rather than silently discarded. This gives referring offices a respectful path to supply material and preserves Yusra’s service promise: referrals are not rejected for missing records, but incomplete material is never represented as clinically ready.
A potentially urgent finding in outside material is a separate safety exception. Administrative staff must not interpret the image or decide urgency; they should flag the concern and route it promptly to the responsible clinician or established clinical escalation owner. Routine missing-record reminders must never delay that review.
Measure success as a before/after trend: among new-patient appointments requiring outside material, track the share marked ready (both components, matched and usable) by the defined pre-visit checkpoint, using the same definition for a baseline period before the gate and each period after launch. Review alongside repeat requests, delayed or unused appointments, and office-level patterns so an apparent improvement does not hide extra burden or delayed care. This target is a proposed management measure, not an observed rate. Residual risks include nonresponse, wrong routing, and clinically important material arriving too late; the gate cannot eliminate them.
DECISION
Yusra should authorize the single pre-visit records-readiness gate, with herself as accountable owner and the records coordinator as operational owner, for launch before October. This is the decision: make required study plus report, verified receipt, and safe exception routing the one standard intake control.

criteria.description: 存在名为 cravenhurst_records_root_cause_briefing.docx 的可读 DOCX 文件。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证确切的文件名、DOCX 有效性以及文档是否打开。

original.criterion: A readable DOCX file named cravenhurst_records_root_cause_briefing.docx is present.
original.grader_hint: Verify the exact filename, DOCX validity, and that the document opens.

criteria.description: 渲染的备忘录不超过三页。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用标准离线办公渲染器渲染 DOCX 并计数页面。

original.criterion: The rendered memo is no more than three pages.
original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX with a standard offline office renderer and count pages.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将克雷文赫斯特耳鼻喉科和听力学列为设置。
criteria.grader_hint: 在呈现的文本中搜索组织名称。

original.criterion: The memo identifies Cravenhurst ENT & Audiology as the setting.
original.grader_hint: Search the rendered text for the organisation name.

criteria.description: 该备忘录的受众是临床运营经理尤斯拉·贝尔曼 (Yusra Behrmann)，或者明确将其受众定为临床运营经理。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认指定的接收者和决策角色。

original.criterion: The memo is addressed to or explicitly frames its audience as Yusra Behrmann, clinical operations manager.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both the named recipient and decision-making role.

criteria.description: 备忘录指出，大约五分之一的新患者到达时不需要外部成像或听力图材料。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受保留大致比率和人口的等效措辞。

original.criterion: The memo states that roughly one in five new patients arrives without required outside imaging or audiogram material.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent wording that preserves the approximate rate and population.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将丢失的外部记录与无法使用或在办理登机手续时被烧毁的约会联系起来，而不是仅仅将问题视为文书工作带来的不便。
criteria.grader_hint: 在签到或访问期间寻找明确的操作结果。

original.criterion: The memo connects missing outside records to appointments being unusable or burned at check-in, rather than treating the issue as mere paperwork inconvenience.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit operational consequence at check-in or during the visit.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将决策范围与计划于 10 月份推出的第五家提供商联系起来。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证十月与供应商扩展之间存在关联。

original.criterion: The memo links the decision horizon to the planned fifth provider in October.
original.grader_hint: Verify that October and provider expansion are connected.

criteria.description: 备忘录将传真确认单、Zendesk工单和排程备注列为可用的证据线索。
criteria.grader_hint: 这三种类型的线索必须出现或被清晰地改写表述。

original.criterion: The memo names fax confirmations, Zendesk tickets, and scheduling notes as the available evidence traces.
original.grader_hint: All three trace types must appear or be clearly paraphrased.

criteria.description: 备忘录区分了四种合理的解释，而不是将它们合并为一个笼统的流程失败。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认对表格、排程脚本、提醒模板和变更后的传真号码这些解释进行了分别处理。

original.criterion: The memo distinguishes the four plausible explanations rather than collapsing them into one generic process failure.
original.grader_hint: Confirm separate treatment of the form, scheduling script, reminder template, and changed fax-number explanations.

criteria.description: 转诊传真表格缺少病历字段被描述为一种可能的上游遗漏机制。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录必须解释这种遗漏如何导致病历无法送达。

original.criterion: The referral fax form's lack of a records field is described as a possible upstream omission mechanism.
original.grader_hint: The memo must explain how the omission could cause records not to arrive.

criteria.description: 排程脚本仅请求影像而不请求报告的情况被描述为一种独立的故障模式。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求认识到影像及其报告不可互换。

original.criterion: The scheduling script's request for imaging but not the report is described as a distinct failure mode.
original.grader_hint: Require recognition that an image and its report are not interchangeable.

criteria.description: 春季提醒模板的编辑被视为一项有时限的变更，可能解释缺失病历频率的变化。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的时间推理，而不仅仅是重复假设。

original.criterion: The spring reminder-template edit is treated as a time-bounded change that could explain a shift in missing-record frequency.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit temporal reasoning, not just repetition of the hypothesis.

criteria.description: 变更后的接收传真号码被视为一种传输或路由故障，可能对转诊办公室的影响不同于内部脚本。
criteria.grader_hint: 该解释应识别外部路由机制。

original.criterion: The changed intake fax number is treated as a transmission or routing failure that may affect referring offices differently from internal scripts.
original.grader_hint: The explanation should identify the external-routing mechanism.

criteria.description: 备忘录根据时间性、来源覆盖范围、复发情况或佐证来评估假设，而不是仅仅因为某个原因听起来合理就选择它。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求至少两个明确的比较维度。

original.criterion: The memo evaluates hypotheses against timing, source coverage, recurrence, or corroboration instead of choosing a cause solely because it sounds plausible.
original.grader_hint: Require at least two explicit comparison dimensions.

criteria.description: 备忘录确定了一个主要解释或一个界限清晰的因果组合，而不是呈现四个同等重要的原因。
criteria.grader_hint: 只有当主导因素明确无误时，才接受排名结论。

original.criterion: The memo identifies one leading explanation or one clearly bounded causal combination, rather than presenting four co-equal causes.
original.grader_hint: A ranked conclusion is acceptable only if one lead is unambiguous.

criteria.description: 主要解释得到了后续或重复证据的支持（如要求所示），同时备忘录承认这些线索并不能证明因果关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找支持性的持续性以及经过适当限定的证据主张。

original.criterion: The leading explanation is supported by later or repeated evidence as requested, while the memo acknowledges that the traces do not prove causation.
original.grader_hint: Look for both supporting persistence and an appropriately qualified evidentiary claim.

criteria.description: 备忘录说明了哪些证据可以证实主要解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受与所选原因相关的具体病历比较、时间戳或路由检查。

original.criterion: The memo states what evidence would confirm the leading explanation.
original.grader_hint: Accept concrete record comparisons, timestamps, or routing checks tied to the selected cause.

criteria.description: 备忘录说明了哪些证据会削弱或证伪主要解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 提出的反证必须具体且相关。

original.criterion: The memo states what evidence would weaken or falsify the leading explanation.
original.grader_hint: The proposed disconfirming evidence must be specific and relevant.

criteria.description: 备忘录将简报中提供的信息与为预测所做的假设区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 标签、表格或明确的文字叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者必须能够分辨哪些主张是提供的事实，哪些是假设。

original.criterion: The memo separates information given in the brief from assumptions made for projection.
original.grader_hint: A reader must be able to tell which claims are supplied facts and which are assumed.

criteria.description: 备忘录确定了由于缺乏干净数据集而导致的重要未知项。
criteria.evidence: 局限性或不确定性文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 示例包括分母、时间段、转诊办公室分布或特定原因的计数。

original.criterion: The memo identifies important unknowns caused by the absence of a clean dataset.
original.grader_hint: Examples include denominator, time period, referral-office distribution, or cause-specific counts.

criteria.description: 十月之前的任何预测结果都明确取决于所述的假设或情景。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝将未经限定的预测作为观察到的结果陈述。

original.criterion: Any projected outcome before October is explicitly conditional on stated assumptions or scenarios.
original.grader_hint: Reject an unqualified forecast stated as an observed result.

criteria.description: 预测涉及预约容量、返工、延误或其他与决策相关的运营结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 该结果必须对十月的供应商扩展决策至关重要。

original.criterion: The projection addresses appointment capacity, rework, delays, or another decision-relevant operational outcome.
original.grader_hint: The outcome must matter to the October expansion decision.

criteria.description: 备忘录不得将简报中的五分之一比例转化为无依据的精确计数、节省金额或供应商产能主张。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否没有将虚构的数量、美元价值、百分比变化或确切预测作为事实呈现。

original.criterion: The memo does not convert the one-in-five brief figure into unsupported precise counts, savings, or provider-capacity claims.
original.grader_hint: Check that no invented volume, dollar value, percentage change, or exact forecast is presented as fact.

criteria.description: 备忘录解释了为什么拟议的变更预计能解决所选机制，而不仅仅是症状。
criteria.grader_hint: 追溯变更从因果机制到更早病历可用性的过程。

original.criterion: The memo explains why the proposed change is expected to address the selected mechanism, not merely the symptom.
original.grader_hint: Trace the change from causal mechanism to earlier record availability.

criteria.description: 备忘录提出恰好一项主要的推荐变更。
criteria.grader_hint: 不要将辅助保障措施或测量计为单独的建议；拒绝多个替代方案。

original.criterion: The memo makes exactly one primary recommended change.
original.grader_hint: Do not count supporting safeguards or measurement as separate recommendations; reject multiple alternative calls.

criteria.description: 推荐的变更在操作层面足够具体，能够识别患者病历接收路径中应更改的内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 模糊地呼吁改善沟通是不够的。

original.criterion: The recommended change is operationally specific enough to identify what should be changed in the patient-records intake pathway.
original.grader_hint: A vague call to improve communication is insufficient.

criteria.description: 建议确定了负责的个人或角色。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受具名人员或定义明确的运营角色。

original.criterion: The recommendation identifies an accountable owner or role.
original.grader_hint: Accept a named person or clearly defined operational role.

criteria.description: 建议确定了相对于十月供应商扩展，该措施应在何时到位。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果明确无误，像“十月之前”这样的相对截止日期是可以接受的。

original.criterion: The recommendation identifies when it should be in place relative to the October provider expansion.
original.grader_hint: A relative deadline such as before October is acceptable if unambiguous.

criteria.description: 建议确定了一个控制点，以便在预约丢失之前可以检查病历完整性或路由。
criteria.grader_hint: 该控制必须发生在预约使用得到保护之前或足够早的时候。

original.criterion: The recommendation identifies a control point where record completeness or routing can be checked before the appointment is lost.
original.grader_hint: The control must occur before or early enough to protect appointment use.

criteria.description: 备忘录提出了一个可衡量的成功指标，与所需的外部病历按时到达挂钩。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受具有明确定义的分子和分母概念的比率、计数、完整性度量或趋势。

original.criterion: The memo proposes a measurable success indicator tied to required outside records arriving in time.
original.grader_hint: Accept a rate, count, completeness measure, or trend with a defined numerator and denominator concept.

criteria.description: 成功衡量标准包含比较期、基线或前后对比逻辑。
criteria.grader_hint: 该衡量标准必须支持判断变更是否有效。

original.criterion: The success measure has a comparison period, baseline, or before-and-after logic.
original.grader_hint: The measure must support judging whether the change worked.

criteria.description: 该备忘录在定义记录完整性时，区分了影像检查研究与相关的报告。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求在临床相关的情况下明确识别这两个组成部分。

original.criterion: The memo distinguishes an imaging study from the associated report when defining record completeness.
original.grader_hint: Require explicit recognition of both components where clinically relevant.

criteria.description: 该备忘录认为记录需要可供临床使用，而不仅仅是已发送或已记录为已传输。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找接收情况、可读性、正确的患者匹配或临床医生的可用性。

original.criterion: The memo treats records as needing to be available for clinical use, not merely sent or logged as transmitted.
original.grader_hint: Look for receipt, legibility, correct patient matching, or clinician availability.

criteria.description: 该备忘录包含处理已接收但不可读、不匹配、不完整或以其他方式不可用的记录的方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 任何具体的不可用记录处置方式都是可接受的，只要它保持了安全性。

original.criterion: The memo includes a way to handle a record that is received but unreadable, mismatched, incomplete, or otherwise unusable.
original.grader_hint: Any concrete unusable-record disposition is acceptable if it preserves safety.

criteria.description: 该备忘录保留了一条途径，允许转诊办公室或患者提供缺失的材料，而不将缺失的记录视为静默取消预约的理由。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找有记录的恢复或升级路径。

original.criterion: The memo preserves a route for the referring office or patient to supply missing material without treating a missing record as a reason to silently discard the appointment.
original.grader_hint: Look for a documented recovery or escalation path.

criteria.description: 该备忘录明确处理了对高量转诊办公室的非正式承诺。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须承认该承诺，而不是忽视它。

original.criterion: The memo addresses the informal promise to the high-volume referring office explicitly.
original.grader_hint: The promise must be acknowledged rather than ignored.

original.criterion: The memo gives the severe exception a separate escalation or clinical-review path rather than folding it into routine reminder or scheduling guidance.
original.grader_hint: A generic 'follow up' statement is insufficient; require prompt clinical ownership or escalation.

criteria.description: 该备忘录不对患者进行诊断，不解读外部影像，也不声称行政人员可以决定临床紧迫性。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查整个文档，看是否有超出行政分诊和升级范围的临床结论。

original.criterion: The memo does not diagnose the patient, interpret an outside image, or claim that administrative staff can decide clinical urgency.
original.grader_hint: Check the whole document for clinical conclusions beyond administrative triage and escalation.

criteria.description: 该备忘录指出，常规的缺失记录处理不得延迟对潜在紧急临床问题的升级。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求相对于普通行政工作流程具有明确的优先级。

original.criterion: The memo states that routine missing-record handling must not delay escalation of a potentially urgent clinical concern.
original.grader_hint: Require explicit priority over ordinary administrative workflow.

criteria.description: 该备忘录包含一种注重隐私的处理传真确认、工单和笔记的方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受最小必要处理、安全路由或避免不必要的患者细节。

original.criterion: The memo includes a privacy-conscious approach to fax confirmations, tickets, and notes.
original.grader_hint: Accept minimum-necessary handling, secure routing, or avoiding unnecessary patient details.

criteria.description: 该备忘录要求在将外部材料视为属于该预约之前，先进行身份或患者记录匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找至少两个适当的匹配要素或等效验证。

original.criterion: The memo requires identity or patient-record matching before outside material is treated as belonging to the appointment.
original.grader_hint: Look for at least two appropriate matching elements or equivalent verification.

criteria.description: 该备忘录要求记录状态、来源以及记录接收或跟进的日期或时间。
criteria.grader_hint: 文档期望必须支持可审计性和交接。

original.criterion: The memo calls for documenting the status, source, and date or time of record receipt or follow-up.
original.grader_hint: The documentation expectation must support auditability and handoff.

criteria.description: 该备忘录指定了解决缺失或不可用记录的责任人，而不是让责任分散。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受一个具有清晰交接边界的基于角色的所有者。

original.criterion: The memo assigns ownership for resolving a missing or unusable record rather than leaving responsibility diffuse.
original.grader_hint: Accept a role-based owner with a clear handoff boundary.

criteria.description: 该备忘录解释了所选变更应如何同时适用于内部调度人员和外部转诊办公室。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求涵盖接收通道的双方，而不仅仅是内部员工。

original.criterion: The memo explains how the selected change should work for both internal scheduling staff and external referring offices.
original.grader_hint: Require both sides of the intake pathway, not only internal staff.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认转诊办公室可能有不同的缺失记录原因或模式。
criteria.grader_hint: 笼统地声称某一原因影响所有办公室不应获得认可。

original.criterion: The memo acknowledges that referring offices may have different causes or patterns of missing records.
original.grader_hint: A blanket claim that one cause affects every office should not receive credit.

criteria.description: 该备忘录提议监测意外影响，如不必要的重复请求、护理延误或增加的行政负担。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须出现至少一种合理的意外影响及其察觉方式。

original.criterion: The memo proposes monitoring for unintended effects such as unnecessary repeat requests, delayed care, or increased administrative burden.
original.grader_hint: At least one plausible unintended effect and a way to notice it must appear.

criteria.description: 该备忘录确定了传输故障与请求或文档故障之间的合理区别。
criteria.grader_hint: 这种区别应影响哪些证据或控制措施是相关的。

original.criterion: The memo identifies a reasonable distinction between a transmission failure and a request or documentation failure.
original.grader_hint: The distinction should affect what evidence or control is relevant.

criteria.description: 该备忘录使用时间顺序或版本/变更时机来评估春季提醒模板的解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求不仅仅提及春季编辑。

original.criterion: The memo uses chronology or version/change timing to assess the spring reminder-template explanation.
original.grader_hint: Require more than naming the spring edit.

criteria.description: 该备忘录使用路由或交付证据来评估更改传真号码的解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找与目标号码相关的确认或失败模式。

original.criterion: The memo uses routing or delivery evidence to assess the changed-fax-number explanation.
original.grader_hint: Look for confirmation or failure patterns tied to the destination number.

criteria.description: 该备忘录使用内容或请求语言证据来评估缺失字段和缺失报告的解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 分析必须将员工所请求的内容与实际收到的内容联系起来。

original.criterion: The memo uses content or request-language evidence to assess the missing-field and missing-report explanations.
original.grader_hint: The analysis must connect what staff asked for to what was actually received.

criteria.description: 该备忘录确定了即使在实施建议变更后仍存在的剩余风险。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受外部无响应、错误匹配或临床紧急材料作为示例。

original.criterion: The memo identifies a residual risk even after the recommended change is implemented.
original.grader_hint: Accept external nonresponse, incorrect matching, or clinically urgent material as examples.

criteria.description: 该备忘录说明了该变更无法建立或保证的内容，避免了缺失记录将被消除的绝对声明。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝确信该修复措施将消除所有遗漏记录或所有浪费的就诊。

original.criterion: The memo states what the change cannot establish or guarantee, avoiding an absolute claim that missing records will be eliminated.
original.grader_hint: Reject certainty that the fix will remove all missed records or all wasted visits.

criteria.description: 备忘录中引入的任何数值目标或阈值均被标记为拟议的管理目标或假设，而非观察到的事实。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果目标的地位和测量基础清晰，则该目标是可以接受的。

original.criterion: Any numeric target or threshold introduced by the memo is labeled as a proposed management target or assumption rather than an observed fact.
original.grader_hint: A target is acceptable if its status and measurement basis are clear.

criteria.description: 备忘录的原因结论、预测效果、建议变更、负责人和成功衡量指标相互一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪所选机制贯穿预测和建议；如果各部分指向不同的修复方案，则扣分。

original.criterion: The memo's cause conclusion, projected effect, recommended change, owner, and success measure are mutually consistent.
original.grader_hint: Trace the selected mechanism through the forecast and recommendation; deduct if sections point to different fixes.

criteria.description: 备忘录以一个明确的决定结束，而不是以开放式下一步骤列表或相互竞争的选项结束。
criteria.grader_hint: 结尾应重申一项呼吁，并将支持性行动框架化为实施细节，而非额外的决定。

original.criterion: The memo ends with one clear decision and does not end with an open-ended list of next steps or competing options.
original.grader_hint: The closing should restate one call, with supporting actions framed as implementation details rather than additional decisions.

criteria.description: 高级决策者无需要求作者解码备忘录即可理解问题、证据基础、不确定性、安全边界以及唯一提出的变更。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断清晰度、层级结构、简洁解释，以及术语或未解释的注意事项是否使简报不可用。

original.criterion: A senior decision maker can understand the problem, the evidentiary basis, the uncertainty, the safety boundary, and the one proposed change without asking the author to decode the memo.
original.grader_hint: Judge clarity, hierarchy, concise explanation, and whether jargon or unexplained caveats make the briefing unusable.

criteria.description: 备忘录具有专业可用性：简洁、中立、注重隐私、易读，并且作为医疗保健运营简报（而非系统手册）具有适当的指导性。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估写作质量、视觉可读性、语气，以及文档是否支持真正的执行层决策。

original.criterion: The memo is professionally usable: concise, neutral, privacy-conscious, readable, and appropriately instructional for a healthcare operations briefing rather than a system manual.
original.grader_hint: Assess writing quality, visual legibility, tone, and whether the document supports a real executive decision.

spec.professional_context: This is an enterprise-facing healthcare administration briefing in which a medical secretary turns incomplete operational traces into a safe, decision-ready explanation for clinical operations leadership. The document must communicate facts and uncertainty without pretending to have evidence that was not supplied.
difficulty_sources: Four plausible explanations must be compared using incomplete operational traces rather than selected by instruction.
The solver must project implications under assumptions without inventing unavailable data.
The informal promise must be reconciled with truthful record-status communication and clinical safety.
A rare, severe clinical-information exception must be separated from routine administrative guidance.
The final briefing must make one decision while remaining useful to an executive reader.

authoring_plan.purpose: Create a source-free authored-document task in which the solver must produce an instructional executive briefing memo from the scenario and occupational knowledge, without being handed a causal answer or a local policy.

solver_feasible_content.setting: Cravenhurst ENT & Audiology; Marta Kilbride prepares the memo for Yusra Behrmann before the fifth provider is added in October.
available_facts: Approximately one in five new patients arrives without outside imaging or an audiogram needed for the visit.
The appointment may be burned at check-in.
Available traces are fax confirmations, Zendesk tickets, and scheduling notes.

Four plausible explanations are the missing records field on the referral fax form, the script requesting imaging but not the report, the spring reminder-template edit, and the changed intake fax number.
Yusra has made an informal promise to a high-volume referring office not to reject or delay its referrals for missing records.
A rare severe case involving potentially urgent findings in outside material must be treated separately from routine missing-record handling.
professional_expectations: Separate observed facts, assumptions, projections, and unknowns.
Use chronology, recurrence, corroboration, source coverage, and routing/content evidence to compare competing causes.
Select one leading cause or one explicitly bounded causal combination and explain uncertainty.
Recommend one operational change with owner, timing, control point, and measurable success indicator.
Define record completeness beyond mere transmission; distinguish the image from the associated report.
Protect patient identity and preserve record matching, receipt/status documentation, and auditability.
Create a separate escalation path for possible urgent clinical concerns and do not allow administrative staff to diagnose or determine clinical urgency.
Preserve service to the referring office without falsely representing incomplete material as clinically ready.
Use a conditional scenario or assumption-based projection because no clean underlying dataset is supplied.
End on one decision, not a menu of options or an open-ended next-step list.

gold_logic.expected_shape: A polished, no-more-than-three-page executive briefing memo with a concise problem statement, evidence inventory, comparative hypothesis analysis, one leading explanation, conditional October implication, one recommended change, safety/relationship boundaries, ownership, timing, and measurement.
gold_logic.causal_reasoning: The gold should not require one invented literal answer. It should reward a defensible choice based on the four supplied hypotheses and should accept a bounded combination only when the document explains why the evidence cannot isolate one mechanism. The explanation must use later or repeated traces, distinguish transmission from request-content failures, and state confirmatory and disconfirming evidence.
gold_logic.projection_logic: Because no source dataset is provided, the gold must accept qualitative or formula-based projections under explicit assumptions. It must reject invented measured counts, dollars, patient facts, or precise causal percentages presented as observed.
gold_logic.recommendation_logic: Exactly one primary change is required. Supporting safeguards, communications, ownership, and monitoring are implementation details, not separate recommendations. The recommendation must address the chosen mechanism and include an accountable owner, timing before October, a pre-visit or equivalent control point, and a measurable before/after indicator.
gold_logic.tension_logic: The informal promise must be acknowledged but cannot override truthful communication, record integrity, or clinical safety. The rare potentially urgent-finding case must have a distinct prompt clinical escalation path and cannot be handled as ordinary missing paperwork.
gold_logic.quality_logic: The document should be understandable to Yusra without author clarification, avoid system click-through instructions, remain neutral and privacy-conscious, and close with one clear decision.

constraints_not_to_seed_in_reference: Do not create hidden patient-level records or numerical observations that the solver could not know.
Do not require a private code, exact local form field, exact fax number, or invented legal citation.
Do not force a particular one of the four causes as the only acceptable answer; score reasoning and defensibility.
Do not specify page layout, table count, font, row count, or section order.
authoring_plan.gold_build_method: Have an independent domain reviewer draft a plausible memo using only the request and general healthcare administrative practice, then audit it against all 60 predicates. Revise the rubric only where a criterion is not independently checkable from the submitted DOCX. Render the resulting document offline to verify the page cap and readability.

deliverables.description: A concise executive root-cause briefing memo explaining the missing outside-records problem, weighing competing explanations, projecting implications before October, and making one defensible recommended change.
constraints: The file must be written for Yusra Behrmann as an executive or senior decision maker.
The memo must be no more than three pages.
The memo must make exactly one recommendation and end with that decision.
Observed facts, assumptions, projections, and unknowns must be distinguishable.
Do not include patient identifiers, invented patient-level facts, invented measured rates, unsupported legal claims, or system click instructions.

title_original: cravenhurst ent records root cause briefing
original_instruction:
You are Marta Kilbride, the medical secretary at Cravenhurst ENT & Audiology, preparing a briefing for Yusra Behrmann, our clinical operations manager. About one in five new patients arrives without the outside imaging or audiogram the visit depends on, so the appointment is often burned at check-in; Yusra wants a defensible answer before the fifth provider is added in October. We have only traces rather than a clean dataset—fax confirmations, Zendesk tickets, and scheduling notes—and there are four plausible stories in circulation: the referral fax form has no records field, the scheduling script asks for imaging but not the report, the reminder call dropped that line during a spring template edit, and the intake fax number changed without referring offices being told. Prepare a concise executive root-cause briefing memo that teaches a senior reader how the evidence supports the conclusion, projects the likely operational effect before October under clearly stated assumptions or scenarios, and makes exactly one recommended change. Yusra has already informally promised a high-volume referring office that its referrals will not be rejected or delayed for missing records, although our professional obligations still require us to avoid implying that an incomplete record is safe or ready for clinical use; a rare case involving a potentially urgent finding in outside material is severe enough that it must not disappear inside ordinary missing-record guidance. Explain how these tensions affect the proposed fix without inventing patient facts, measured rates beyond the brief, legal requirements, or savings. Distinguish observed information from assumptions, identify what evidence would confirm or weaken the leading explanation, and make the recommendation specific enough for an executive to understand its owner, timing, control point, and success measure without turning the memo into system click instructions. Use plain, privacy-conscious language and do not include patient identifiers. Write the finished memo to `cravenhurst_records_root_cause_briefing.docx` in the top level of the working directory, keep it to no more than three pages, and end on the single decision rather than a list of future tasks.

---

(The file must be written for Yusra Behrmann as an executive or senior decision maker.; The memo must be no more than three pages.; The memo must make exactly one recommendation and end with that decision.; Observed facts, assumptions, projections, and unknowns must be distinguishable.; Do not include patient identifiers, invented patient-level facts, invented measured rates, unsupported legal claims, or system click instructions.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
